name: Business Architecture
mission_fa: توصیف قابلیت و خدمت دارویی و تعهدات همکاری در نمای تحلیلی
excluded_scope: Every outsourcing agreement being a strategic partnership

queries.query: PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?org WHERE { t:cap c:capabilityBearer ?org . FILTER NOT EXISTS { t:cap l:capabilityRealizedIn ?x } }
PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?cap WHERE { t:service l:serviceCapability ?cap }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?artifact ?org WHERE { { ?artifact a c:BusinessArchitectureView ; l:viewOrganization ?org } UNION { ?artifact a c:StrategicPartnershipAgreement ; c:partnershipParticipant ?org } }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX r: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/refinement/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?product ?capability WHERE { t:service r:serviceProduct ?product ; l:serviceCapability ?capability }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX r: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/refinement/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?org ?source WHERE { t:agreement r:agreementCommitment ?claim . ?claim r:commitmentActor ?org . ?e c:evidenceAssertion ?claim ; c:evidenceRecord ?source }

limits: Selected-signature projection; no proof of entailment preservation outside listed witnesses
Import interfaces are not counted as owned classes
SHACL profile requirements are not global OWL cardinalities
No native OntoUML module export is claimed
Source model semantic decisions, including PROV projection, remain pending

purpose_contract.input: Organizations, a pharmaceutical service specification, a borne capability, and documentary partnership commitments when actually supported.
purpose_contract.output: An analytical architecture view linking organizations, service specifications, capabilities and evidenced collaboration commitments.
purpose_contract.flow: view → organization/service → capability → bearer; strategic agreement → participants/commitment/evidence.
questions: Who bears a capability, including a capability with no recorded exercise?
Which medicinal product or facility gives the service a pharmaceutical scope?
What commitments and documentary evidence support a strategic agreement?

definitions.BusinessArchitectureView: An information artifact representing selected organizational and service relationships for an analytical purpose.
definitions.ServiceOfferingSpecification: An information artifact specifying a service offering; distinct from execution of that service.
definitions.EnterpriseCapability: A capability borne by an organization; its presence does not imply an execution or a quantity of supply capacity.
definitions.PartnerOrganizationRole: A contextual organization role grounded in a strategic partnership agreement.
definitions.StrategicPartnershipAgreement: A proposed relator grounding participants and commitments; the agreement document is a separate source record.

purpose_contract.remaining: Independent real contract evidence and adjudication of agreement/commitment/document identity; not every outsourcing arrangement is a strategic partnership.
